content.text: The independent audit found three plan-breaking details that I’m now enforcing in agent briefs: direct test binaries need package working directories and explicit `-test.timeout`; branch-only `workflow_dispatch` files cannot run unless the workflow exists on the default branch; and top-level inventory equality is insufficient because the shard regex may exceed Windows’ 32,767-character command line and dynamic subtests must also be compared.
